# world-tag scope declaration -- which trees the [Ring N / NAME] + {World: ...}
# requirement enforced by scripts/checks/check_world_tags.py actually reaches.
#
# The requirement's SCOPE lived only in file_is_in_ring3_plus(), a hand-written
# set of path shapes, under a docstring saying the sole deliberate omissions
# were host tooling and vendored code. They were not: apps/, port/ and 38
# first-party libs/ roots sat outside the requirement, undocumented, and most
# of them carry Ring/World tags the gate never reads. A whole library root was
# a quieter exemption than any row of the legacy inventory (#842).
#
# One row per first-party root the sweep enumerates:
#
#   required  every file under the root is inside the requirement
#   partial   some are, and the reason says which
#   exempt    none are, deliberately, and the reason says why
#   unscoped  none are, and that is debt, not a decision
#
# The gate measures every row against the tree on each run, so this file cannot
# drift from the classifier in either direction: a root the tree has and this
# file does not is a finding (nothing enters unjudged), a row whose root is
# gone is a finding (the list only shrinks), a "required" root the classifier
# only partly covers is a finding, and a root the classifier DOES cover while
# this file calls it unscoped or exempt is a finding too. exempt and unscoped
# measure the same, so what separates them is the reason written here.
#
# The counts below are read by the gate and must match the rows present, in
# total and per state, so a root changing state shows up as a changed number
# rather than a moved line. Widening the requirement means moving a root to
# "required" and tagging what is under it; it is never an edit to this file
# alone.
#! roots: 52
#! required: 7
#! partial: 1
#! exempt: 3
#! unscoped: 41
unscoped apps/: first-party app and shared-library code; tags present by convention, not required
unscoped arch/: CPU-architecture contract headers (Ring A); no Ring-3+ file and no backend translation unit exists yet, so nothing is inside the requirement
partial examples/: only <app>/src/main.c is inside (Ring 6); every other app TU, boot files included, is not
unscoped libs/if/: first-party library; tags present by convention, not required or read
unscoped libs/if_ra8_vfs/: first-party library; tags present by convention, not required or read
unscoped libs/ra8_app/: first-party library; tags present by convention, not required or read
unscoped libs/ra8_audio/: first-party library; tags present by convention, not required or read
unscoped libs/ra8_batt/: first-party library; tags present by convention, not required or read
unscoped libs/ra8_board_ek_ra8d2/: first-party library; tags present by convention, not required or read
unscoped libs/ra8_board_ra8p1/: first-party library; tags present by convention, not required or read
unscoped libs/ra8_box/: first-party library; tags present by convention, not required or read
unscoped libs/ra8_c6link/: first-party library; tags present by convention, not required or read
unscoped libs/ra8_cache_store/: first-party library; tags present by convention, not required or read
unscoped libs/ra8_camera/: first-party library; tags present by convention, not required or read
unscoped libs/ra8_camera_io/: first-party library; tags present by convention, not required or read
exempt libs/ra8_core/: Ring 1 BSP and Ring 2 Core, Secure-only by policy, so a World tag would restate the ring

unscoped libs/ra8_dfu/: first-party library; tags present by convention, not required or read
